content.text: InstagramLog InSign UpCloseNever miss a post from laurenlindleyphotoSign up for Instagram to stay in the loop.Sign upLog inTagssxswlaurenlindleyphoto•FollowSXSWMore optionslaurenlindleyphoto Edited•9wBig changes are coming to SXSW 2026!@SXSW 2026 is shorter on the calendar, but the programming itself has not been reduced. What has changed is how much of it now happens at the same time. Music still runs for seven days, but instead of closing out the festival, it now overlaps with Interactive and Film.That shift is going to bring more people to Austin at once and increases crossover between industries. It also creates significantly more competition for attention across the same hours of the day. For planners and brands, this means success is less about how many events you attend and more about where you choose to show up.After photographing SXSW for well over a decade, I can say this year will reward clarity. Knowing your priorities ahead of time is going to matter more than ever, whether you're an attendee, a brand setting up an activation, looking to target a specific track, or you simply need SXSW event photography coverage. I've got all my thoughts on the SXSW 2026 event changes up on a blog this week.
